description: Markdown lint. Any markdown document in, URL-encoded as the text query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), a structure scorecard out: nine rules (heading jumps, duplicate headings, unterminated code fences, empty image alt text, bare URLs, hard tabs, trailing whitespace, mixed bullet markers, long lines), every hit counted with line numbers, a structure/hygiene/readability summary, the rule table beside the verdict. Price: $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
